subject: Next steps: procurement & payment path for Novacare (PO vs card)
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@novacare.com>, ProcureOps AP Team <ap@procureops.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo — procurement & payment path for Novacare

Hi Alice / AP team,

Thanks again for your time today — appreciate the quick walk-through of your use cases. High-level recap and outstanding questions so we can finalize commercial routing: 

- Summary: Novacare is a fit for our Dedicated + private networking setup for PHI-handling workloads. Suggested pilot: 4 vGPUs, 2-week ramp, monitoring + SLO review.
- Procurement questions for AP: do you require a formal PO for initial pilot, or can we process via corporate card for amounts < $25k?
- Vendor onboarding: any required vendor forms (W9, bank details, vendor portal registration)? We attached a short checklist to help (Novacare_PO_requirements.pdf).
- Marketplace: you mentioned potential interest in billing via your cloud marketplace — is that something AP can accept or would it complicate vendor onboarding?

Next steps we propose:
1) You confirm preferred payment path (PO vs corp card vs marketplace).
2) If PO, share vendor onboarding packet and expected PO cadence (Net 30/45/60).
3) If card or marketplace, confirm any internal spend limits or approvals.

If convenient, we can schedule a 15-min call with your procurement admin to walk the onboarding checklist.

Thanks — I'll hold on drafting the SOW until we lock payment route.

Best,
Logan Wright
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0189

Attachment: Novacare_PO_requirements.pdf (pdf)

From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@novacare.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: ProcureOps AP Team <ap@procureops.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 09:34:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-demo — procurement & payment path for Novacare

Hi Logan,

Thanks for the summary — that aligns with what we discussed. A few clarifications from AP side: 

- For pilots under $25k we typically prefer to use the corporate card (simpler, faster). Anything above that will need a PO and our standard vendor setup.
- If PO required: we need a completed vendor packet (W9 for US vendors), bank ACH info or vendor portal entry, and the certs page if you process PHI. Typical vendor onboarding time is 2–3 weeks once paperwork is in.
- Net terms: we usually negotiate Net 30; Net 45 is possible but requires finance approval for new vendors.
- Marketplace: if the solution is offered through our cloud marketplace (we use AWS Marketplace), procurement can approve faster but we must confirm if pricing is identical and whether the marketplace subscription supports SSO/usage attribution the way our IT team needs.

I'll loop in our AP specialist if you want to share the vendor packet and a marketplace SKU.

Best,
Alice Chen
Director, Vendor Management | Novacare Health
alice.chen@novacare.com | +1 (617) 555-2323

Attachment: ProcurementChecklist.docx (docx)

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@novacare.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2027 11:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo — procurement & payment path for Novacare

Thanks Alice — this is helpful. Quick reply with proposed next steps so we can move to contracting: 

Option A — Corporate card (recommended for pilot):
- If the expected pilot spend is < $25k, we can accept card and start immediately. No vendor packet required; we will still provide a short SOW that your legal team can sign.

Option B — PO + vendor onboarding:
- We'll fill out W9 and vendor packet items you list. Expect 2–3 week onboarding; pricing will be the same. If Net 45 is required, we'll note that as a special term for finance review.

Option C — Marketplace purchase:
- I'll confirm with our Partnerships team whether we can provide an exact SKU and usage attribution for your AWS Marketplace accounting. If marketplace is allowed by AP, that will likely be the fastest for enterprise procurement.

Requested actions from Novacare: 
1) Confirm preferred route (A/B/C).
2) If B, please send the vendor packet and any legal templates to route to our finance/legal teams.
3) If C, confirm marketplace details and point of contact for procurement to validate the SKU.

I'll draft a short SOW for the pilot and start preparing the DocuSign envelope — holding until payment path is confirmed. Sharing HubSpot deal for your reference: https://hubspot.example/deal/RD-3487

Marissa — fyi I added you to coordinate SOW + billing. Karthik — able to provide a card vs PO pricing summary if needed.

Thanks,
Logan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
